description: JournalPayload — the 11th OutputKind (Journal Assessor, plan §3.2). The journal's one output: an entry or a consolidation, landing in the dedicated journal_entries table, OFF the fact/finding/nexus chain. This is the authored contract artifact matching legba.data.provenance.models.JournalPayload (the pydantic model is the live enforcement; this file is the documented Iglu schema for the journal_entries.schema_uri 'iglu:legba/journal/jsonschema/1-0-0').

entry_kind.description: The discriminator. Entries are pure append; only consolidations supersede.

body.description: The narrative (markdown, with inline [[ref:<uuid>]] citation markers).

claims.description: Per-claim citation binding (§3.6) — the chip-to-span source of truth.

cited_substrate_refs.description: Flat union of every ref cited anywhere in the body (query convenience). The binding lives in `claims`.

supersedes.description: consolidation → prior consolidation; NULL for entries AND for the first-ever consolidation.

honesty_flags.description: Forced DETERMINISTICALLY by a non-LLM post-step (§10) — never trusted as agent-self-reported.
